text:
Maya: Quick PR sweep — noticed Optimize Toolkit docs have 3 inconsistent examples for prefix caching and one uses the old SDK call (client.generate) which breaks snippet tests. Need a small PR to standardize. /cc @Sam @Elena
Sam: grabbing it. can you paste the failing test logs?
docs-bot: PR opened by Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 — title: 'optkit: unify cache/quant snippets' :eyes: 
Elena: I skimmed. There's also a link to the quant profile YAML that points to master branch; we should update to use the release tag so examples are immutable.
Ben: If we change the YAML link, we must bump the sample output tokens in the sample generation section; build CI compares exact output for smoke tests.
Maya: noted. I'll open a follow-up PR to update sample output. For now, can we land the snippet fixes only?
Sam: +1 on landing snippet fixes first. I'll re-run the docs CI after I patch the SDK calls.
Sam: patch diff suggestion:
```diff
- client.generate(prompt)
+ client.stream(prompt, timeout_ms=12000)  # streaming example and explicit timeout
```
Elena: Also reword sentence under 'KV prefetch' — it currently implies caching always reduces latency. Suggest: "KV prefetch can reduce compute cost for repeated prefixes but may increase tail latency for cold-starts."
Maya: perfect wording. put that sentence in the PR description so release notes capture the nuance.
Ben: I'm wary of changing the quant recommendation to 4-bit by default. Let's add an advisory block recommending an A/B run with your eval set and include perf budget numbers.
Maya: agreed; I'll add: "Recommendation: test 4-bit vs 8-bit on your eval set; expect ~1.8-2.5x throughput vs 8-bit but validate quality regressions."
Sam: CI clean locally after the snippet patch. docs-bot: deploy preview updated: https://deploy.preview.redwood/inference/optkit/472 :rocket: 
Maya: thanks! I'll coordinate the follow-up PR to bump sample tokens and change the YAML link after this lands. Ping me if anything blocks.
Elena: quick follow-up — can we add a one-liner to the SDK note: 'for streaming, include timeout_ms param to avoid orphaned connections'?
Maya: added to my todo list for the follow-up PR.
Ben: merging after the tests pass. :shipit: 
docs-bot: PR #472 merged by Ben — changelog entry: "optkit: standardize caching/streaming snippets, clarify KV prefetch tradeoffs"
Maya: thanks all. quick retrospective: shorter diffs, smaller scoped PRs, and run smokegen locally before opening. I'll drop a 3-line checklist in the docs repo root (docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) as a follow-up.
